title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School, located in Gwinnett County, Georgia, received its fourth AI-generated bomb threat of the school year on Monday. School officials placed the campus on lockdown out of an abundance of caution, and it later returned to normal operations. The latest threat followed a pattern seen in recent incidents, involving a masked phone number. This is the fourth such threat this school year.

Gwinnett County school police are now working with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI to determine who is responsible for the threats. Authorities have not announced any arrests or identified a suspect in connection with the threats. The article does not say what specific steps will happen next, only that the investigation is ongoing.
